title: Construction of Compound wall at Rajapur Bay Lighthouse Station
summary: E-tender (percentage rate) to build a stone masonry compound wall with observation platforms, internal pathways and paver blocks at Rajapur Bay Lighthouse, Madban, Ratnagiri district, Maharashtra, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

sites.name: Rajapur Bay Lighthouse, At post Madban, Tal. Rajapur, Dist. Ratnagiri 416702
sites.work: Construction of compound wall with three laterite masonry observation platforms and internal pathways

scope.item: Excavation in hard rock (blasting prohibited) in foundation trenches, lift up to 1.5 m, disposal within 50 m (Rs 1,523.05/cum; Rs 6,76,919.57)
Centering and shuttering for foundations, footings, bases etc. (Rs 392.15/sqm; Rs 2,49,407.40)
Cement concrete 1:4:8 (40 mm aggregate) in foundation and plinth (Rs 6,812.00/cum; Rs 5,39,169.80)
Random rubble masonry with hard stone in foundation and plinth in CM 1:6, levelling with CC 1:6:12 (Rs 7,311.25/cum; Rs 6,58,012.50)
Filling excavated earth/morrum in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations in 20 cm layers (Rs 196.00/cum; Rs 58,270.80)
Damp-proof course 50 mm thick CC 1:2:4 (Rs 495.75/sqm; Rs 4,848.44)
Coursed rubble masonry with hard stone (first sort) in superstructure in CM 1:6 (Rs 10,741.60/cum; Rs 26,63,916.80)
Cement concrete 1:2:4 in coping including centering, shuttering and finishing (Rs 9,895.20/cum; Rs 3,36,436.80)
18 mm cement plaster in two coats (12 mm 1:5 + 6 mm 1:3), rough finish (Rs 537.45/sqm; Rs 14,65,916.37)
Premium acrylic smooth exterior paint with silicone additives (Asian/Snowcem/Berger), two or more coats over primer (Rs 245.05/sqm; Rs 6,68,383.68)
Reinforced cement concrete 1:1.5:3 in kerbs, steps and the like, excluding centering and reinforcement (Rs 8,821.65/cum; Rs 6,71,768.65)
60 mm factory-made M-30 CC interlocking paver blocks over 50 mm sand bed (Rs 972.00/sqm; Rs 11,97,261.00)
Synthetic enamel painting two or more coats on kerb stone, flag mast and CC chairs over cement primer (Rs 226.25/sqm; Rs 2,16,860.63)
Priming coat with low-VOC primer (red oxide zinc chromate on steel/iron) (Rs 73.95/sqm; Rs 70,881.08)
Providing, supplying and storing potable water by tanker for work and drinking (Rs 2,84,341.67)
Additional transportation cost of material due to remote site about 65 km from Ratnagiri/Rajapur, incomplete road and Jaitapur Nuclear Power Plant security requirements (Rs 9,76,239.51)

money.performance_security: Performance guarantee 5% of contract value (FDR/BG) released on satisfactory completion, plus security deposit 5% deducted from each RA bill released after 6 months defect liability period
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST; BOQ total Rs 1,07,38,634.70. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months; MSME firms must also pay EMD. Percentage rate tender; quantities may vary +/-15%. LD 1.5% per month, max 10% of estimated cost.

period.completion: 09 months from date of issue of work order
period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with tender limit equal to or above the estimated cost, registered with Central/State Govt/Municipal Corporation

Similar works (residential or commercial building or compound wall construction) in last 7 years: three works each >= Rs 42.95 lakh (40%), or two each >= Rs 64.43 lakh (60%), or one >= Rs 85.90 lakh (80%); sub-contractor experience not considered
Average annual turnover at least 30% of estimated cost (Rs 32,51,600) over last 3 financial years ending 31.03.2023, CA certified
PAN, GST registration, ITR for FY 2020-21 to 2022-23
Tender acceptance letter, no-relatives declaration, unconditional bid undertaking, notarised non-blacklisting affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper, site visit declaration
Technical evaluation minimum 60% (financial 20, experience 30, performance, pre-bid attendance 10, site visit report 10, bar chart 5, personnel 10, tools and machinery 5)
specs: Compound wall in coursed rubble hard stone masonry on random rubble foundation, CC 1:2:4 coping, plaster and acrylic exterior paint
Three laterite stone masonry observation decks (A, B, C) about 3.0 x 2.0 m, 1.8 m high, soil-filled with 230 mm soling and 100 mm PCC 1:3:6, 600 mm laterite parapet on sea side, 9-10 steps
Internal roads/pathways connecting the three observation points; interlocking paver blocks M-30, 60 mm
OPC 53 grade / sulphate resisting cement from manufacturers of 1 million t/yr capacity; sand to IS 2686; bricks to IS 1077; CPWD specifications
